name: Grand Lobby
description: The magnificent heart of the Grand Paradox Hotel, usually a testament to art deco elegance. Currently, it's a testament to dimensional chaos. The chandelier is dripping upwards. A Victorian gentleman is arguing with a tentacled alien about checkout times. The floor tiles are playing musical chairs with each other. Reality keeps stuttering like a bad video stream. The elevator bank glows ominously to the north, while the front desk somehow faces seventeen directions at once.
